title: Ready Is Not Released: Preserving Scheduling Choice
description: Change release capacity and synthetic tail urgency to see which ready turns remain reorderable outside a congested inference engine. Deterministic six-turn mechanism illustration on analyst-authored inputs: no mean-CVaR estimator, adaptive queue-pressure controller, trace replay, or reproduction of measured P95/throughput results. The 71.4% / 3.50x figures are author-reported, not demo outputs.
